g.text: V7 Tcell_6 source-refit | nonexclusive state programs
Top: corresponding identity / candidate subtype / state. Left: working annotation and cell count.
Size: detection among source-measured cells; x: source coverage <80%. Color: relative expression within each gene.
Rows are exploratory partitions, not accepted fine subtypes. Candidate labels are review associations.
Reference panel IDs belong to the cited source, not the V7 row IDs. Original V7 annotation is retained.
